activities.instructions: Ayuda a la rana a cruzar el río eligiendo el nenúfar correcto en cada salto.
activities.prompt: Partida de 8 rondas para repasar el tema jugando.

rounds.prompt: Which option means “The team needs more reliable data”?

options.text: What the team needs is more reliable data.
What is more reliable data the team needs.
What the team need are more reliable data.

rounds.explanation: The what-clause is not a direct question.

rounds.prompt: Which sentence places the location at the front without changing the main order?

options.text: At the routes, the old station met.
The routes at met the old station.
At the old station, the routes met.

rounds.explanation: A fronted place phrase is followed by normal subject-verb order.

rounds.prompt: What the committee needs [gap1] a clearer timetable.
rounds.explanation: The standard pattern uses singular is.

rounds.prompt: It was [gap1] Bristol that the study began.
rounds.explanation: In Bristol is the location phrase.

rounds.prompt: Which option emphasises the time of the decision?

options.text: What after lunch they decided was the decision.
It was after lunch that they made the decision.
After lunch was it that they made the decision.

rounds.explanation: It-cleft focuses the time phrase and uses that.

rounds.prompt: Which option correctly combines a what-cleft and a singular focus?

options.text: What did surprise everyone was the final cost.
What surprised everyone the final cost was.
What surprised everyone was the final cost.

rounds.explanation: Was completes the standard what-cleft with the singular focus.

rounds.prompt: What surprised everyone [gap1] the final cost.
rounds.explanation: The past context calls for was.

rounds.prompt: It was the sudden change in funding [gap1] surprised the panel.
rounds.explanation: That refers to the focused thing and introduces the clause.

activities.explanation: Al terminar la partida verás la media de aciertos y la explicación de cada ronda fallada.

activities.instructions: Colócate en el carril de la respuesta correcta antes de cruzar cada puerta.
activities.prompt: Partida de 8 rondas para repasar el tema jugando.

rounds.prompt: What surprised the auditors [gap1] the final cost.
rounds.explanation: Was agrees with the standard singular what-clause pattern.

rounds.prompt: It was after lunch [gap1] the meeting started.
rounds.explanation: That links a focused time phrase to the clause.

rounds.prompt: What we need [gap1] more reliable data.
rounds.explanation: What we need is the standard singular what-cleft pattern.

rounds.prompt: [gap1] the closing paragraph, the writer addresses the risks.
rounds.explanation: In the paragraph establishes the discourse frame.

rounds.prompt: Which option emphasises who reset the system?

options.text: It was the technician who reset the system.
It the technician was reset the system.
The technician it was reset the system.

rounds.explanation: The it-cleft places the technician in focus.

rounds.prompt: It was Maya, rather than Tom, [gap1] called the supplier.
rounds.explanation: Who refers to a person in an it-cleft.

rounds.prompt: Which sentence focuses the result of the experiment?

options.text: What revealed the experiment was a pattern.
What did the experiment reveal was a pattern.
What the experiment revealed was a pattern in the data.

rounds.explanation: What-clause presents the experiment’s finding as the topic.

rounds.prompt: It was the sudden change [gap1] surprised the panel.
rounds.explanation: That introduces the focused clause after a thing.

activities.explanation: Al terminar la partida verás la media de aciertos y la explicación de cada ronda fallada.

activities.instructions: Apila los fragmentos en orden para levantar la frase.
activities.prompt: Partida de 8 rondas para repasar el tema jugando.

rounds.prompt: Which option correctly focuses the finance team?

options.text: It the finance team was that approved the request.
It was the finance team that approved the request.
What was the finance team approved the request.

rounds.explanation: The cleft requires that before the finite clause.

rounds.prompt: It was at the old station [gap1] the two routes met.
rounds.explanation: Where is natural after a focused location in this pattern.

rounds.prompt: Which option focuses the person who raised the objection?

options.text: What raised the objection was Dr Singh who.
It was Dr Singh who raised the objection.
Dr Singh was it raised the objection.

rounds.explanation: Who is suitable for the focused person.

rounds.prompt: Choose the sentence meaning “We need clearer guidance”.

options.text: What is we need clearer guidance.
What we need are clearer guidance.
What we need is clearer guidance.

rounds.explanation: What-clause acts as the subject; it is not a question.

rounds.prompt: It was the finance team [gap1] approved the request.
rounds.explanation: That introduces the focused clause in this it-cleft.

rounds.prompt: Which option focuses the archive as the discovery location?

options.text: It was the archive who found the letter.
It was in the archive that we found the letter.
What we found the letter was archive.

rounds.explanation: The place phrase is followed by that and the clause.

rounds.prompt: It was Maya [gap1] called the supplier.
rounds.explanation: Who is natural when the focused element is a person.

rounds.prompt: Which option sets the time frame naturally?

options.text: On the committee, Friday published the report.
On Friday, the committee published the report.
The committee on Friday published? the report.

rounds.explanation: The fronted time phrase is followed by normal clause order.

activities.explanation: Al terminar la partida verás la media de aciertos y la explicación de cada ronda fallada.
